en:
Everyone else seems to have been given
an appropriate lab...
So how come my lab has a sci-fi theme!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?
Krgh... You seem rather unperturbed by this...
Shuichi, you can be very insensitive at times...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
